metadata.title: A Three-Layer Dependency-and-Logic Audit for Mathematical Proofs and AI-Generated Claims: The S/M/P × D/L Framework
metadata.description: We introduce a structured audit framework for mathematical proofs, conjectures, and AI-generated mathematical claims. The framework operates on three layers—Semantic, Mathematical, and Programming—and for each layer examines two complementary dimensions: internal Dependency relations and internal Logic-structure discipline. The resulting S/M/P × D/L matrix provides six elementary audit cells (S*D, S*L, M*D, M*L, P*D, P*L) plus cross-layer mapping checks. Version 10 further extends the curated sample suite to 86 reports and adds ten new high-risk audits from the OpenAI 700+ mathematical manuscript corpus that are marked as Lean-formalized yet remain structurally high-risk: exact derandomization of logarithmic space (L=RL=BPL), matrix multiplication exponent at most 9/4, Hilbert's 16th problem (uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles), Mahler conjecture for general convex bodies, non-amenability of Thompson's group F, Bogomolov-Pop function-field reconstruction, Falconer distance conjecture, Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture, Erdős reciprocal-sum conjecture with quasipolynomial Szemerédi bounds, and short Egyptian fractions. The attached SMPDL_v2.1_sample_reports_86files.zip contains 86 markdown reports used to compute the joint SHA-256 fingerprint be26f9d200470a8b3521ad667d633e04b23a3c83ef44e1140db3483a0e5bd624.
